verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS travel and expense platform with apps and a hosted MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. Navan Edge's personalization from booking history and the MCP auth details are adjacent topics, not opt-out controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
